checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: M1 failing tests pin ingest/register/check/sync contract; M2 implement tools/build_game_teasers.py; M3 wire markers in index.html, replace hand-written placeholder, README tree, gates, delivery

impact_assessment.why: Private-game teasers are managed by hand: files dropped into docs/assets/games and markup edited directly, with no manifest, no optimization and no consistency check.
impact_assessment.benefits: Teaser publishing becomes one command per screenshot plus sync, with the same optimization, verification and atomicity the dossier media pipeline already has.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sync owning markup could clobber hand edits - mitigated by a fully-owned block between explicit markers and a placeholder render when the manifest is empty; dependency: new tool imports build_dossier_media primitives - mitigated by importing stable functions only, no network reuse; concurrency: two syncs could interleave - mitigated by atomic file replaces and manifesto single-writer CLI use; state: teasers.json corruption - mitigated by temp-plus-replace writes with a .bak shadow.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests before implementation; bounded marker-scoped replace in sync, idempotent on re-run; README tree updated in the same commit.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: M1 failing tests pin the archived card and integration description; M2 archive+describe the GitHub repo via gh; M3 dossier_sync refresh, gates, delivery

impact_assessment.why: Aegean-Licensing was vendored into AIKit (d80d2e2) but GitHub and the site still present it as a live standalone project, so publishers and users see two homes for the same license texts.
impact_assessment.benefits: One canonical home: the GitHub repo is archived with a pointer to AIKit, the dossier card shows archived with the integration description, and the catalogue tests pin it.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: dossier_sync rewrites several site files from live GitHub facts - mitigated by running its own checks plus the project gates; dependency: gh CLI authenticated as AegeanWorks with repo scope, no code change needed; concurrency: parallel session owns the AIKit license-gate work in the root workspace - mitigated by not touching AIKit root files; state: repositories.json and atlas snapshot rewritten twice (sync run) - mitigated by committing drift separately if it reappears.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test before the archive; description mirrors the Aegean-Reforge artifact pattern; archive is reversible via unarchive if the user objects.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: complete the interrupted dossier catalogue sync for the published Knot repository, regenerate the stale codebase map, and land the pending Kiln catalogue refresh so all Phase 4 gates pass.

impact_assessment.why: AegeanWorks Phase 4 is red: the guidelines gate reports .aikit/codebase_map.md stale and the test gate fails because orphaned Knot media (written by knot's brand-and-publish) has no catalogue entry; the published public repo Knot is missing from the catalogue while its media is present.
impact_assessment.benefits: A green 6/6 gate run; the public catalogue reflects both published repositories (Kiln and Knot); the codebase map matches tracked sources; no other agent's work is overwritten.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: dossier_sync.sync_published rewrites 7 catalogue files and the media builder regenerates schema-2 manifests; dependency: GitHub facts and raw asset fetch need network; concurrency: another session touched this tree at 12:15 and 14:39 but no live AegeanWorks process remains; state: uncommitted Kiln/Knot files must be preserved and committed together, not discarded.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the supported dossier_sync.sync_published and build_dossier_media builder rather than hand-editing generated files; confirm no live process holds the tree; regenerate the map with update_knowledge_base.py; run the full check --allow-dirty --all-gates and only commit when 6/6 pass; do not push.
